news.title: Calestous Juma Engineering Fellows strengthen Purdue’s research ties with Sub-Saharan Africa
news.summary_en: The inaugural Calestous Juma Engineering Fellows, hosted by Global Engineering Programs and Partnerships (GEPP), are Celestin Twizere and Eddy Odari.

news.title: Purdue AI Racing heads back to Laguna Seca, gears up for toughest challenge yet
news.summary_en: The stakes and level of difficulty will be much higher when Purdue AI Racing (PAIR) returns to WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca in Monterey, California, on Sept. 3.

news.title: Indianapolis profile: Masha Novoselova
news.summary_en: Masha Novoselova values the Purdue experience in Indianapolis for its blend of rigorous and enjoyable electrical engineering classes, meaningful internship opportunities, and spaces to connect with friends and explore the city.

news.title: CCE alum to achieve lifelong space dream aboard Purdue 1
news.summary_en: Jason Williamson will become the first Purdue civil engineer to travel to space during the Purdue 1 suborbital flight in 2027.

news.title: ME's Malshe testifies to US Senate about innovation in small businesses
news.summary_en: During a Senate Small Business Committee hearing before the Congressional recess, Sen. Todd Young (R-IN) asked CEO of Arkwright Space Dr. Ajay P. Malshe about the benefits of small businesses over larger companies.

news.title: Purdue researcher Jay Gore awarded prestigious ASME Holley Medal for 'brilliance of the art'
news.summary_en: Purdue Engineering is pleased to announce that Jay Gore, Reilly University Chair Professor in the School of Mechanical Engineering, has been awarded the highly prestigious 2026 Holley Medal by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).
